items.title: India-based Spintronics AI weighs GaN chip fab in Madhya Pradesh
items.description: Hyderabad-based Spintronics AI Semiconductors said on October 27 that it is evaluating the feasibility of establishing a gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductor fabrication facility at Vikram Udyogapuri in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, with a total proposed investment …
